contentMap.productCategory: AI Image Generation and AI Video Generation
contentMap.targetAudience: Professionals seeking high-quality AI-generated visuals and videos, including creative teams, marketers, and content creators

hero.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
hero.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 (Image Generation) and Seedance 1.5 Pro (Video Generation) - advanced foundation models developed by ByteDance for high-quality visual content creation.
hero.supportingLine: From text prompts, images, or scripts, generate professional visuals and videos with powerful multimodal AI systems.

productSections.name: Seedream 4.5
productSections.label: Feature 1
productSections.headline: AI Image Generation with Seedream 4.5
productSections.description: Seedream 4.5 is a high-performance multimodal image generation system designed to produce high-resolution, high-fidelity images from text prompts and visual inputs. The model unifies text-to-image synthesis, image editing, and multi-image composition within a single framework.

features.title: Advanced Text–Image Alignment
features.description: Accurately translates prompts into visuals with improved semantic understanding.

features.title: High-Resolution Output
features.description: Generate native images up to 1K–4K resolution with strong visual fidelity.

features.title: Superior Typographic Rendering
features.description: Optimized for posters, ads, and text-heavy visual designs.

features.title: Multi-Image Composition with Identity Preservation
features.description: Combines multiple inputs while accurately maintaining subject consistency.

features.title: Strong Structural Fidelity
features.description: Maintains composition, layout, and scene structure with high precision.

productSections.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro
productSections.label: Additional Feature
productSections.headline: AI Video Generation with Seedance 1.5 Pro by Bytedance
productSections.description: Seedance 1.5 Pro is a next-generation generative model designed for native audio-visual generation, enabling synchronized creation of video and sound together. Built on a dual-branch diffusion transformer architecture, the model integrates cross-modal learning to produce coherent visual and audio outputs.

features.title: Key Capabilities of Seedance 1.5 Pro
features.description: Seedance enables professional-grade AI video production with narrative coherence and realistic motion. Text-to-Video Generation: Create videos directly from text prompts. Audio-Visual Synchronization: Generate video and audio simultaneously with strong multimodal alignment. Multilingual Lip-Sync: Supports multilingual and dialect-level lip synchronization. Cinematic Camera Control: Generate videos with dynamic camera movement and cinematic storytelling. 10× Faster Inference: Optimized inference pipeline significantly improves generation speed.

plans.name: Seedream 4.5 (AI Image Generation)
includes: Enhanced typographic rendering for posters, ads & text-heavy designs

plans.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro (AI Video Generation)
includes: Fast inference for quicker video production

referenceMap.heroPattern: Split top-of-page brand/hero area with logo presence, large headline, short supporting paragraph, and a compact bullet/value-prop list; hero is text-forward with limited visual media and strong above-the-fold hierarchy.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Single-screen hero followed by a lead-capture block, then content sections arranged as stacked modules with clear headers; pattern favors linear progression over complex navigation, with repeated section framing and strong separation between modules.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Utility-focused form card and content blocks with simple rectangular surfaces, minimal ornamentation, and clear borders/boxed containment; emphasis on functional clarity rather than decorative depth.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: Primary CTA in the hero, with secondary conversion reinforced in a dedicated form section; CTA strategy is lead-generation oriented, using short action verbs and repeated conversion opportunities rather than many competing buttons.
referenceMap.pricingPattern: No visible pricing module in the reference layout; pricing should be omitted or deferred if following this pattern.
referenceMap.footerMode: Not visible in the provided reference slice; infer a minimal utility footer if extended, with low emphasis and no heavy navigation.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Primarily text-first with small inline iconography and logo treatment; no evidence of large hero media, video, or gallery-driven presentation in the reference section.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Stacked product/feature sections with strong headings, short explanatory copy, and bulletized capability lists; supports progressive disclosure by introducing one product module at a time with clear labels and distinct subheadings.
referenceMap.formPattern: Dedicated lead form card placed directly after hero content; compact, high-intent form architecture with visible title, hidden tracking fields, and structured field grouping for conversion capture.
referenceMap.animationStyle: Static, conversion-focused presentation with no clear motion system evident in the provided HTML beyond potential carousel scaffolding commented out in code.
designNotes: Prioritize high-clarity conversion hierarchy over storytelling complexity.
Use compact bullet lists to summarize differentiators quickly.
Keep form placement early to capture high-intent users.
Favor stacked modules and clean separators for long-form B2B content.
If media is added, keep it supportive rather than dominant.
Maintain a professional, enterprise-oriented visual tone with minimal decorative treatment.

personality.buyer: Creative teams, marketers, content creators, and enterprise innovation buyers seeking high-quality multimodal visual generation
personality.reasoning: The product is clearly in the AI/generative media category, so the visual language should feel cinematic and intelligent rather than generic SaaS. Because recent AI pages already used creative-studio, cinematic-ai, and operational-dashboard, this direction intentionally shifts to a more editorial-luxury presentation with strong contrast and brand-tied orange identity. Techjockey’s brand colors strongly indicate an orange-led palette, so the page should feel warm, energetic, and high-utility while still premium. The experience should highlight multimodal creation, model capability, and enterprise readiness with layered storytelling and high-end visual composition.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The hero headline is long, so a compact 40px size preserves hierarchy and prevents awkward wrapping while keeping the layout premium and balanced.

colours.colourReason: Brand color #ff6b00 is used as the primary hero background and CTA color per rule. White and charcoal provide clean contrast, while the orange brand identity gives the page a distinct, memorable visual signature without drifting into an unrelated purple AI palette.

layout.heroReason: A centered hero creates a fresh variation from prior split-layout AI pages and keeps the long headline, multi-line subheads, and banner features highly legible. The orange background delivers immediate brand recognition and energy, while the centered composition feels editorial and premium.
layout.featureReason: Alternating sections create a more narrative, magazine-like product story and avoid repeating the previously used accordion, split-panel, or spotlight-grid patterns. This works especially well for separating Seedream image capabilities from Seedance video capabilities with stronger visual contrast.
layout.darkSectionFor: Use a charcoal-black contrast band for the Seedance 1.5 Pro video section and the pricing/cart area to create depth and signal advanced technology.

personality.imageryDirection: Use a large editorial-style product visual area with layered mock generation frames: image tiles, timeline strips, prompt chips, and compact model cards. For the image section, show polished composition thumbnails, text-rendering examples, and multi-image fusion panels. For the video section, show a cinematic frame sequence, waveform/audio sync accents, and motion-control overlays. Keep visuals abstract and UI-rich rather than literal photography-heavy, with subtle depth, white space, and precise framing.
personality.designPersonality: A premium editorial AI marketplace page with bold brand-orange energy, clean white structure, and high-precision content framing. It should feel like a trusted enterprise-grade launch page for advanced generative models: visually intelligent, selective, and high value. The overall tone is confident, modern, and polished, with strong typographic hierarchy, precise spacing, and subtle motion.

layoutStrategy.hero: Use a strong above-the-fold hierarchy with headline, subheadline, and supporting line stacked prominently. Since no key hero media is defined, keep the layout text-led with compact value props and a bold primary CTA. Preserve generous spacing and high contrast for immediate readability.
layoutStrategy.features: Break the page into clearly separated product modules. Seedream 4.5 should use a feature grid for its five capability points. Seedance 1.5 Pro should use a spotlight-style content block because its feature data is denser and more narrative. Keep each module boxed and easy to scan.
layoutStrategy.proof: Place trust badges early, then testimonials after pricing to support late-stage evaluation. Use restrained card styling, gold ratings, and clear author hierarchy. Avoid visual clutter; the proof layer should validate, not compete.
layoutStrategy.pricing: Use two quote-led pricing cards with inclusion lists, starting price only where available, and strong CTA repetition. Make pricing feel consultative rather than self-serve. Do not over-design this section; it should support lead capture intent.
layoutStrategy.form: No form section should be introduced because includeForm is false. Conversion should happen through CTAs only.

designIntent.tokenProfileHint: Use a professional marketing/product default: Plus Jakarta Sans for headings and Inter for body. Favor a high-trust, enterprise-credible palette with a dark or deep primary hero treatment and a vivid accent for CTAs. Keep card surfaces white, borders subtle, spacing generous, and motion subtle.
designIntent.figmaReadySummary: Design a text-forward category landing page for two ByteDance generative AI products with a strong hero, early trust badges, separate product feature sections, quote-led pricing cards, and testimonial proof. Use a structured B2B layout with clear containment, minimal ornamentation, and conversion-oriented CTAs. No form module should be added; keep the page deterministic, scanable, and enterprise-credible.

figmaBuildPlan.tokenProfileHint: Default Techjockey marketing system: Plus Jakarta Sans headings with Inter body; use brand primary/accent for a high-trust, conversion-led category page.

sections.variantHint: Text-first hero with strong hierarchy; split layout only if a small product/media block is needed, otherwise keep content-forward and compact
sections.notes: Use a strong above-the-fold brand/hero area with headline, supporting line, and compact value-prop list. Secondary CTA is absent in content; render only primary CTA. Keep text dominant and avoid large media treatment. Use dark primary hero background with light text per brand memory, and place supporting bullets/value props beneath the supporting line.

Keep it visually distinct from the Seedream section using spacing and section framing, not heavy decoration.

Seedream card should emphasize request/quote behavior; Seedance card should display the provided starting price. Keep pricing presentation functional and restrained. Do not invent discounts or EMI. Use quote-oriented CTAs and concise includes lists.

Each card must include star rating, italic quote, bold author, and grey designation/company line. Keep quotes readable and card heights balanced through consistent spacing.

sections.variantHint: Minimal footer only; low-emphasis utility treatment

sections.notes: Stack all hero content vertically. Keep headline compact and allow natural wrapping; preserve the full supporting line. Primary CTA should be full-width. Since no secondary CTA exists, do not fabricate one. Keep the value-prop list short and scannable, using compact bullets under the supporting copy.

sections.variantHint: Badge row that wraps into two lines if needed

sections.variantHint: Expanded text card for the multi-capability feature description

sections.variantHint: Two stacked pricing cards with full-width CTA buttons

sections.variantHint: Single-column testimonial cards with touch-friendly spacing

Keep minimal and low-emphasis, matching the desktop footer treatment.
